meta.name: The Studio
meta.description: Desperate for celebrity approval, the newly appointed head of a movie studio and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

videos.title: The Promotion
videos.overview: Matt Remick is named the new head of Continental Studios—and put in charge of a project that threatens public humiliation.

videos.title: The Oner
videos.overview: The filming of an intricate sunset shot becomes complicated by Matt's set visit.

videos.title: The Note
videos.overview: Matt feels nervous about giving legendary director Ron Howard a difficult piece of feedback.

videos.title: The Missing Reel
videos.overview: A reel of film goes missing, sending Matt and Sal on a race against the clock to find it.

videos.title: The War
videos.overview: Frustrated by her position in the office hierarchy, Quinn wages a war against Sal.

videos.title: The Pediatric Oncologist
videos.overview: Matt’s ego is put to the test when his new doctor girlfriend brings him to a charity gala.

videos.title: Casting
videos.overview: The Continental team scrambles to come up with a movie cast that won't offend anyone.

videos.title: The Golden Globes
videos.overview: Matt tries to get Zoë Kravitz to thank him in her award acceptance speech.

videos.title: CinemaCon (1)
videos.overview: When Matt sets out to throw the coolest party at CinemaCon, it backfires in psychedelic fashion.

videos.title: The Presentation (2)
videos.overview: If Matt's team doesn't pull off an amazing CinemaCon presentation, the studio will be sold...to a tech company.

meta.slogan: They don't make films. They make movies.
